extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: Ambulatory Surgical Centers (ASCs) are designated facilities that specialize in outpatient

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: procedures that do not require admission to a hospital. Procedures that can be performed in

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: an ASC are statutorily defined by CMS and reviewed each year for potential additions and/or

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: deletions. The purpose of this policy is to establish how we cover and pay for these services.

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: This policy applies to all Devoted Health plans.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: We cover our members' medically-necessary ASC services in accordance with the CMS ASC

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Covered Procedures List. Coverage for the primary surgical procedure includes all related

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● Diagnostic or therapeutic services directly related to the surgical procedure

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● Drugs and biologicals that are not considered separately payable

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● Implanted prosthetics, including intra-ocular lenses (IOLs), and related accessories

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● Implanted Durable Medical Equipment (DME) and related accessories and supplies

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● CLIA-waived laboratory tests related to the surgical procedure

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● Nursing, technicians, and their related services

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● Radiological services that are not considered separately payable

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● Supervision of an anesthetist by the operating surgeon

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● Supplies and equipment for the administration and monitoring of anesthesia

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● Supplies and other items required to perform the surgery (e.g., surgical dressings,

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: We also cover the following ancillary services when they are integral to the provision of

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● Acquisition of corneal tissue for corneal transplant procedures

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● Implantable items with pass-through status under the Outpatient Prospective

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● Drugs and biologicals for which separate payment is allowed under the OPPS

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● Radiology services and certain diagnostic tests for which separate payment is allowed

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● Non-opioid pain management drugs and biologicals that function as a supply when

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Prior authorization is required for some ASC services including, but not limited to,

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: arthroscopies, gender reassignment, ophthalmological surgeries, and spinal procedures.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: To ensure the most seamless experience for our members, requests must be submitted at

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: least 10 business days prior to the scheduled service date.

extracted_content.title: ACRONYMS AND DEFINITIONS
extracted_content.content: Ancillary Services: Services that are separately covered and eligible for additional

extracted_content.title: payment under the ASC PPS.1
extracted_content.content: ASC Services: Surgical procedure, included facility services, and certain separately

extracted_content.title: payment under the ASC PPS.1
extracted_content.content: payable ancillary services under ASC PPS.

extracted_content.title: payment under the ASC PPS.1
extracted_content.content: ASC Status Indicator: A code assigned to each HCPCS code that identifies whether a

extracted_content.title: payment under the ASC PPS.1
extracted_content.content: service is considered separately payable or packaged.2

extracted_content.title: payment under the ASC PPS.1
extracted_content.content: Covered Procedures List: A CMS-maintained list of approved surgical procedures that

extracted_content.title: payment under the ASC PPS.1
extracted_content.content: may be performed in an ASC, consistent with statutory and clinical criteria.3

extracted_content.title: payment under the ASC PPS.1
extracted_content.content: Included Facility Services: ASC services considered packaged as part of a surgical procedure.

extracted_content.title: payment under the ASC PPS.1
extracted_content.content: Non-ASC Services: Services furnished in an ASC that are not in scope under the ASC PPS

extracted_content.title: payment under the ASC PPS.1
extracted_content.content: payment methodology but may be eligible for payment under a different payment

extracted_content.title: payment under the ASC PPS.1
extracted_content.content: NPI: A unique, 10-digit number assigned by CMS to identify healthcare providers in all

extracted_content.title: payment under the ASC PPS.1
extracted_content.content: Prospective Payment System (PPS): A payment methodology that pays

extracted_content.title: payment under the ASC PPS.1
extracted_content.content: predetermined, fixed amounts based on average national costs that are adjusted

extracted_content.title: payment under the ASC PPS.1
extracted_content.content: Rendering Provider: The individual or organization (e.g., laboratory, facility) that

extracted_content.title: payment under the ASC PPS.1
extracted_content.content: performed or supervised the service being billed. On professional claims

extracted_content.title: payment under the ASC PPS.1
extracted_content.content: (CMS‐1500/837P), the rendering provider field may contain either a Type 1 NPI

extracted_content.title: payment under the ASC PPS.1
extracted_content.content: Type 1 NPI: A personal NPI assigned to individual providers (e.g., physicians, NPs).

extracted_content.title: payment under the ASC PPS.1
extracted_content.content: Type 2 NPI: An organizational NPI assigned to entities (e.g., ASCs, hospitals, group

extracted_content.title: payment under the ASC PPS.1
extracted_content.content: practices). Used to identify a facility or organization.
